title: list_cids_with_flag: dynamic SQL string interpolation is unnecessary
description: state/flags.rs list_cids_with_flag builds a SQL string by dynamically appending conditions based on Option<bool> parameters. Since there are only 4 combinations (seen=None/Some, flagged=None/Some), this could use 4 static queries or match arms with fixed SQL. The dynamic approach requires manual binding ordering to match conditions, which is a footgun for maintainers. Suggested rewrite: match (seen, flagged) { (None, None) => query_all, (Some(s), None) => query_by_seen, ... }.
